text: Ɓen tawɓe si gootel e ɗin musiibaaji heɓiiɓe,ɓe wi'ira yarluyee e jebbilaare:Menen ko men jeyaaɓe Allah,Himo Waɗa e amen kon ko O muuyi,ko ka Makko kadi woni ruttorde amen ñalnde darngal,ko Kanko Woni Tagɗo men,O Teddiniri men neemaaji seertuɗi, ko ka Makko woni ruttorde amen e lannoode fiyaaku amen.
